title: FGFR2 is a Crucial Factor for Adipose-Derived Mesenchymal Stem Cells in Promoting Diabetic Foot Ulcer Healing Through Angiogenesis.
authors: Cao, Jing; Liu, Zichao; An, Wenqiang; Zhang, Xin; Li, Zhujun; Li, Lijie; Ji, Hailian; Zhang, Sen; Long, Xiao; Yang, Yuemei
journal: Journal of cellular and molecular medicine
one_liner_zh: 该文研究间充质干细胞通过FGFR2促进糖尿病足溃疡愈合的血管生成机制，属纯湿实验与表达分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Diabetic foot ulcers (DFUs) remain a significant clinical challenge due to the lack of effective treatments, severely impacting patients' quality of life. Mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) have shown potential in promoting DFU healing; however, the underlying mechanisms are not yet fully understood. This study investigates the role of adipose-derived mesenchymal stem cells (ADSCs) in DFU healing, with a particular focus on angiogenesis. Gene expression profiles from the GSE7014 and GSE80178 datasets in the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database were analyzed. Differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were intersected with angiogenesis-related genes from the GeneCards database, identifying 35 angiogenesis-related DEGs (An-DEGs). Key genes were selected using Cytoscape software and machine learning. The pro-angiogenic effects of ADSCs were validated through in vivo and in vitro experiments, assessing their role in DFU healing. The DEGs from DFU patients were enriched in pathways such as angiogenesis and collagen-containing extracellular matrix. ADSCs promoted angiogenesis and wound healing by upregulating FGFR2 and secreting FGF, activating the FGF-PI3K/Akt-HIF-1alpha-VEGF axis. Additionally, ADSCs mediated secretion of VEGF concerting this effect. FGFR2 plays a pivotal role in ADSCs' mediated DFU healing by driving angiogenesis.
abstract_zh: 糖尿病足溃疡（DFUs）因缺乏有效治疗手段，仍是一项重大临床挑战，严重影响患者生活质量。间充质干细胞（MSCs）在促进DFU愈合方面显示出潜力；然而，其潜在机制尚未完全阐明。本研究探讨脂肪来源间充质干细胞（ADSCs）在DFU愈合中的作用，特别关注血管生成。分析了基因表达综合（GEO）数据库中GSE7014和GSE80178数据集的基因表达谱。将差异表达基因（DEGs）与GeneCards数据库中的血管生成相关基因取交集，鉴定出35个血管生成相关DEGs（An-DEGs）。使用Cytoscape软件和机器学习筛选关键基因。通过体内和体外实验验证ADSCs的促血管生成效应，评估其在DFU愈合中的作用。DFU患者的DEGs富集于血管生成和含胶原细胞外基质等通路。ADSCs通过上调FGFR2并分泌FGF，激活FGF-PI3K/Akt-HIF-1alpha-VEGF轴，促进血管生成和伤口愈合。此外，ADSCs介导的VEGF分泌协同增强了这一效应。FGFR2在ADSCs介导的DFU愈合中通过驱动血管生成发挥关键作用。
